title: Tennis shocker: World No. 1 Sabalenka loses to a 20-year-old ranked 35th!
summary:
Have you ever been so close to winning but then everything fell apart? That's what happened to Aryna Sabalenka, the best women's tennis player in the world. At the Cincinnati Open, she was winning big in both sets against Sara Bejlek, a 20-year-old from Czechia ranked only 35th. But Bejlek refused to give up.

In the first set, Sabalenka was ahead 5-1 in the tiebreak — that means she only needed two more points to win the set. But Bejlek fought back and won it 7-6. Then in the second set, Sabalenka led 4-1, but again Bejlek stormed back to win 6-4. The final score was 7-6, 6-4. It was a huge upset!

This is a big deal because Sabalenka is supposed to defend her title at the US Open, which starts on August 30. She's trying to become the first woman since Serena Williams in 2014 to win three US Opens in a row. But she's been struggling lately. Since March, she's only made it to one semifinal. Now her spot as world number one is in danger. If Elena Rybakina reaches the final in Cincinnati, she could take over the top ranking.

For Bejlek, this is the biggest win of her life. 'I totally lost my words,' she said. 'I just keep believing and that was the key today.' She'll play Madison Keys next. What a day for the underdog!
why_it_matters: Sports rankings can change quickly, and this match shows that belief and staying calm under pressure can turn a losing position into a victory.
